neighbours.label: the copula after an abstract evaluative subject whose content the rest of the sentence will identify (the worst part is, the real reason was, the main problem is), as opposed to a copula describing a concrete person or thing
fire: We loved the hotel, but the only drawback was the noise from the street.
The trip was long. The hardest part was saying goodbye at the airport.
Critics praised the film, and the biggest surprise is the ending.
Sales are down, and the underlying cause is a shortage of chips.
Many people try the diet, but the catch is that it costs a lot.
The garden looks simple, yet the secret is in the soil.
Nobody expected it, but the key question was who would pay.
The plan sounds good. The trouble is that nobody has time.
quiet: We loved the hotel, and my sister was happy with her room.
The trip was long, and our driver was tired by the evening.
Critics praised the film, and its director is now in demand.
Sales are down, and our manager is worried about the summer.
Many people try the diet, and my uncle is one of them.
The garden looks simple, and our dog is often asleep in it.
Nobody expected it, but my father was calm all evening.
The plan sounds good, and my friends are ready to help.

predictions: specificational copulas 0.6-0.95; descriptive copulas after a person or pet subject below 0.3
notes: Card: ' is' x21, ' was' x8 after 'the real reason', 'the main event', 'the pitfall', 'the spectacular part', 'the worst part', 'the magic'. Probe: 'real reason they left was' 0.954, 'worst part is' 0.909, 'main problem is' 0.752, 'best thing about summer is' 0.678, 'magic was' 0.650; descriptive 'The house is on the corner' 0.386 and 'The cat is sleeping' 0.410 leak, 'My brother was a teacher' 0.042. Near misses use possessive person or pet subjects; definite thing subjects may leak.
